The RXEL - 22 over voltage relay is generally used in protection, control and 
 supervision applications where accurate and repeatable operation at the set 
 operating value and a high continuous voltage rating are required and where a 
 high resetting ratio is not an important consideration

The RXEL-22 is especially recommended for applications where substantial 
 voltage harmonic components are present

text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The RXEL - 22 over voltage relay is generally used in protection, control and 
 supervision applications where accurate and repeatable operation at the set 
 operating value and a high continuous voltage rating are required and where a 
 high resetting ratio is not an important consideration
The RXEL-22 is especially recommended for applications where substantial 
 voltage harmonic components are present
The first draft initiated by Eng. Mohye Eldeen Ghames, tested by Eng. 
 Wael ali Mghazi at 20 June 2007, and accepted by General 
 Manager Eng. Mohamed Nasr Eldeen and approved by Eng. Youseef Mahmod Ali Head 
 Sector of Esna 
 hydro-power station.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category, 
 (safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc).
Issue work permit including the 
 team work name.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The transformer is out of service
Isolate the relay from PT`S
Tools 
and Equipment
Secondary 1-ph. injection test set 
 (sverker 650 - sweeden)
Multimeter
Test - plug handle (RTXH 18)
Test wires
Variable resistance (0-450)ohm
Work to be 
carried out
Connect the circuit as shown in fig (1)
Increase the voltage gradually until reach the operating value
Ensure that the relay operates at the setting voltage value 6 v
ensure that the relay operates at the setting time value 0.5 sec
Record this values on the test sheet
Return relay to ts normal position by Take off the equipments and the wires
